characters.name: Bjørnen
characters.prompt: A large brown bear with a friendly yet gullible expression. The bear has a short, stubby tail due to an unfortunate fishing accident. Its fur is thick and shaggy, and it has big, gentle eyes.

characters.name: Ræven
characters.prompt: A clever and cunning fox with a mischievous look in its eyes. It has a sleek, reddish-orange coat with a white-tipped bushy tail. The fox often sports a sly grin and is always looking for an opportunity to trick others.

cleanedMainImagePrompt: An illustration showing the iconic scene of a bear sitting on ice with its tail submerged in a hole, looking confused as a fox watches from a distance, smirking. The snowy landscape is detailed, with a clear, cold sky and a few trees in the background.
modernMainImagePrompt: A modern adaptation of the folktale featuring a bear on a frozen city lake, trying to fish with its tail while a wily fox, wearing a hoodie and sneakers, watches amusedly from the edge. Cars pass by in the background, and a city skyline can be seen.
childMainImagePrompt: A child-friendly version of the tale where a cartoon-like bear with big, round eyes and a small tail attempts to fish with its tail on a bright, colorful ice sheet. Nearby, a playful cartoon fox giggles, surrounded by friendly forest animals under a sunny, smiling sky.
simplifiedMainImagePrompt: På norsk, et bilde av en bjørn som sitter på isen og fisker med halen, mens en lur rev ser på. Det er vinter, med snødekte trær i bakgrunnen og en klar himmel ovenfor.
englishMainImagePrompt: An illustration for an English version of the tale depicting the bear losing its tail in a humorous manner while the fox looks on with amusement. The landscape should be wintry and charming, emphasizing the comical yet sly nature of the story.
